top_signals.title: Bassman Warns of ‘Nightmare Scenario’ Amplifying US Bond Selloff
top_signals.summary: Harley Bassman, pioneer of one of the most widely followed indicators for US Treasuries, warns that a little-noticed feature of the market is threatening to worsen a monthslong selloff and push bond yields even higher.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Social Security cost-of-living adjustment for 2027 may be above average. Some say it's not enough
top_signals.summary: The Social Security Administration is expected to announce the cost-of-living adjustment for 2027. Projections point to a higher-than-average increase.
